turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
I'll think aloud with one: "Mona ___ (eat) rice for lunch."
Who is it? Mona, one woman, so she. With she, I can't leave eat as it is. I add -s: eats.
Result: Mona eats rice for lunch.
Rule: with he, she or it, the action word takes -s or -es.
Right: The dog runs in the garden.
Wrong: The dog run in the garden.
Now you. Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
